_doc: GOLD6 picks for Kendwa-Unguja, 7 Oct 2026. Lanes hold <=3; no 4s were needed. Criteria in order: can't-miss for the north tip · authentic over touristic · teaches something · confirmed over unverified. Fewer places is the point. Cut venues leave data.js, both CSVs and every #venue- link.

why.kilindi: the domes; the strangest building on the coast, 2026 rates live
why.zuri-zanzibar: the spice garden and EarthCheck design gold; Kendwa's serious kitchen
why.emerson-hurumzi: the Stone Town roof with taarab — the one night in town worth staying for

why.yasa: laksa and rösti Benedict, prices re-confirmed 2026

why.gold-zanzibar: the five-star on Kendwa sand, 2026 trading (seasonal closure noted)
why.essque-zalu: The Jetty on stilts, on the quiet east side; 2026 low-season days noted

landings.label: Where the boats land — and the island grows

why.kizimbani: the clove decree still standing as farming

why.machnoo: the village price, pweza wa nazi
why.lukmaan: the whole Zanzibari repertoire at a counter in Stone Town

italian.label: The other kitchens — Italian ovens and a Hanoi broth

why.mama-mia-nungwi: the Italian room on the strip
why.hanoi-house: a 24-hour pho broth; merged in from the one-venue 'other kitchens' lane

why.jf-kili: Kilimanjaro coffee from the owners' farm
why.passion-thyme: a French bakery and deli (corrected from 'salad place')
why.mahi-mahi: breakfast at the empty end of the beach

why.makofi: the weekly BBQ night and Roman pizza

chefs-eat.label: After service — where the strip eats late

why.highland: pool tables and the football — the last room awake

why.sunset-kendwa: the quiet half of Kendwa sand
why.z-rooftop: the best sunset seat, minimum spend stated up front

why.kendwa-rocks: where the Full Moon Party began in 1996
why.langi-langi: the long-standing deck above the water

why.nungwi-fish-market: the auction at dawn and the grills at dusk
why.nungwi-village: the dukas and the morning plates

lanes_dropped.ethnic: a one-venue lane once Essence (menu is mixed, not Indian — the lane's premise) and MJ's (nothing verifiable) were cut; Hanoi House merged into the Italian lane
lanes_dropped.fast-food: all three (Waves, The Corner, Kibanda) unverified and miscast: The Corner is a sit-down Italian, Kibanda a beach club; the late plate lives in Sur le pouce

cut.emerson-spice: the second Emerson roof; told once — the Hurumzi roof (taarab, the original tea house) stays
cut.z-hotel: the house itself; its restaurant (Sexy Fish) and rooftop bar carry it — one hotel, not three entries
cut.riu-palace: a closed all-inclusive; and RIU now runs two adults-only hotels on the cape, easy to confuse
cut.doubletree-nungwi: no longer a DoubleTree — renamed (Turaco, Marriott Tribute) in 2026; a chain room, not a reason to come
cut.zava: unverified; the dish the old card was built on is not what reviewers describe
cut.kivulini: unverified; Machnoo and Combo 1990 carry the village kitchen
cut.tamtam: unverified; third Swahili kitchen in the same streets
cut.essence-kendwa: the lane's premise (an Indian kitchen) is contradicted: the menu is mixed
cut.mj-restaurant: nothing on the old card could be verified
cut.the-corner: miscast (a sit-down Italian, not a fast plate); a fourth Italian
cut.kibanda: a beach club, unverified; the sand bars are covered
cut.mangis: listings contradictory since August; not settled
cut.bobo-beach: a sunbed deal; fourth sand bar
cut.kajibange: unverified and its 'inland, no view' framing is contradicted
cut.coccobello: a halfway landmark only; nothing to go for
cut.diving-poseidon: third dive desk; two are enough
cut.freddie-mercury: no card points to it any more
cut.house-of-wonders: closed to visitors since the December 2020 collapse (re-checked 7 Oct 2026); the culture card keeps it as an exterior on the Forodhani walk, the map pin goes

cards_cut: 127 fold cards -> see card_plan.json: merges are listed per card ('from'); dropped outright: sea-stories|Königsberg comes into the harbour (fourth 'hard water' story), sea-stories|The boats are still being built (told in craft), bars|Mangi's, bars|Kajibange, coffee-gardens|Kivulini garden, coffee-gardens|Maisha Beach daytime, quartiers|Mnarani & the point (in landmarks), quartiers|Nungwi east (Essque Zalu has its own card), quartiers|Off the cape x3 (in Autour), culture|Baraka (in the turtles card), the old hot board (replaced, dated 7 Oct 2026)
